en.title: Supreme Court Upholds Disability Access in Cinemas, Signals Ongoing Legal Battles
en.summary: The Supreme Court rejected a proposal to cap accessibility requirements in cinemas, ensuring wheelchair seating and assistive listening devices remain mandatory. Meanwhile, a new legal analysis warns that certain website accessibility widgets may expose businesses to lawsuits, and a community project installed wheelchair‑friendly picnic tables at West Elementary. Advocates also urged Montgomery County to expand sign‑language interpretation and captioning for deaf residents.

highlights.title: Supreme Court Rejects Cinema Accessibility Cap
Your Accessibility Widget Might Be Making You a Legal Target
West Elementary receives accessible picnic tables through loac church's community initiative
Advocates call for greater accessibility for deaf residents in Montgomery County

zh-TW.title: 最高法院維護電影院無障礙設施，彰顯法律持續爭議
zh-TW.summary: 最高法院駁回限制電影院無障礙設施的提案，確保輪椅座位與助聽設備仍為必備。另有文章警示某些網站無障礙小工具可能使企業面臨訴訟風險，同時西小學透過社區計畫安裝了無障礙野餐桌。倡導者亦呼籲蒙哥馬利縣加強手語翻譯與字幕服務，以提升聾人居民的無障礙環境。

highlights.title: 最高法院駁回電影院無障礙上限
您的無障礙小工具可能讓您成為法律目標
西小學透過當地教會的社區計畫獲得無障礙野餐桌
